title: Test installer on real Ubuntu 22.04 VPS
description: Run the final prebuilt installer on the approved disposable Ubuntu 22.04 one-vCPU/low-RAM VPS and record sanitized evidence.
acceptanceCriteria: VPS identity, OS, architecture, vCPU, RAM, swap, disk, and access method are recorded without credentials
The pinned one-line command downloads/verifies/extracts the artifact without `npm ci`, `npm install`, or `next build` on the VPS
Service, health endpoint, static assets, login, and basic data persistence work after install
A failed readiness path can restore the previous release or clearly reports first-install failure with actionable logs

steps.details: Connect through the approved test path, verify OS/architecture/resources/Node runtime and disposable data location, and record only non-secret metadata.
Run the exact documented version-pinned installer with a disposable port/admin configuration supplied through protected local input, not evidence files.
Check service state, `/api/health`, login/protected route, public/static assets, and data persistence; capture sanitized statuses and timings.
Perform a controlled failed-readiness or invalid-artifact rehearsal and confirm no published release is silently left active.

technicalNotes: This task cannot be marked passed without actual VPS access and evidence. Do not print passwords, SSH keys, tokens, or full env files.
